scope: One-seed, five fixed Mac subjects; whole native sampling bundle versus frozen earlier greedy control. Not an isolated presence-penalty causal experiment, general success rate or phone test.
method: Root individually viewed both exact actual USDZ robot PNGs, then checked canonical scene dimensions. Four rejected responses were not repaired or rendered.

observations: Both exact views show the actual blue model with a wide shallow rectangular head rather than a cube.
The two yellow balls touch; feet overlap into a common lower block. These are noted without relying on them to establish the unambiguous head-dimension failure.
The arm assemblies sit above the head like antennae. No new unrequested pose rule was added to the acceptance gate.
